summary: Looks at a deployment problem with TLS-based EAP methods: large certificates and long certificate chains, combined with authenticators that drop an EAP session after only 40 to 50 round trips. The document describes the problem in detail and the potential solutions. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A very long ID card takes so many small handovers that the doorman gives up. This explains how to make it shorter.

questions: eap session dropped after many round trips
